// @control-plane
// GREEN fixture for `control-plane-pii-free` — the IDENTITY-relevant slice (P-ID-03 / P-024).
// The lint MUST admit this. This is the OPAQUE-ID `iam.*` event projection from P-ID-02: actor and
// subject are attributed by opaque `principal_id` ONLY (never the erasable profile), and the event
// carries no name/email/body — `contains_personal_data` is structurally `false`. This is exactly
// the shape P-ID-02 freezes so the immutable log can never carry erasable PII (EI-04 §1; ADR-11/OQ-I).
pub struct IamEventProjection {
    pub type_: &'static str,
    pub actor_principal_id: PrincipalId,
    pub subject: IamSubjectRef,
    pub contains_personal_data: bool,
    pub data_role: DataRole,
}
